title: The text model lineup shifted
summary:
The text API gained new model choices while its routing, responses, and queue behavior became more predictable.

DeepSeek-V3 joined as `deepseek`, followed by `qwen-coder`, `mistral`, and `llama`, the latter three with JSON-mode support. `llamalight` was added midweek and removed from the model list two days later. Older Mistral, Command-R, and Llama listings were also removed, while two personas changed providers.

OpenRouter requests now use the model specified by the caller instead of defaulting to DeepSeek Chat. Requests beyond the existing per-IP queue limit return a structured JSON 429; OpenAI search has more room to answer, and text-response handling, streaming, caching, and errors received updates. The image queue wait also changed to a fixed 500 ms.

The JavaScript text-generation example was simplified without losing its optional `jsonMode` documentation. The community-built Polli API Dashboard, which shows real-time text-feed statistics, joined the homepage and README project lists.
